title: Scalar compatibility of the specified strict-tower direct image
statement:
Fix a field $k$, a prime $\ell$ invertible in $k$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a morphism $f:Z\to X$ of separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. For each finite subextension $E\subset\Omega$ let $R_E=\mathcal O_E$, choose a uniformizer $t_E$, and put $A_{E,n}=R_E/t_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. On the small pro-etale sites use the completed coefficient sheaf $\widehat R_{E,W}=\varprojlim_n(A_{E,n})_W$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Let $\mathcal C_E(W)=D^b_c(W,R_E)$ be the derived-complete category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], and let $I_E:\mathcal C_E(Z)\to\mathcal C_E(X)$ be the specified strict-reduction-tower direct image
$$I_EK=R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_{X,n}Rf_{*,A_{E,n}}K_n$$
of [def-weil-derived-direct-image], with its functorial strict-diagram realization [lem-weil-derived-direct-image-composition]. Here $K_n=K\otimes^L_{\widehat R_{E,Z}}(A_{E,n})_Z$ and $\operatorname{Res}_{X,n}$ restricts along the completed coefficient projection. Its bounded constructible values and actual reduction maps are those of [lem-sf-integral-direct-image-constructible]. Let $F_E$ be ordinary total derived direct image over $\widehat R_E$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], and let $\psi_E:F_EK\xrightarrow{\sim}I_EK$ be the normalized reconstruction comparison of [lem-pur-completed-coefficient-pushforward-comparison].

The functor $I_E$ is $R_E$-linear for the scalar actions of [lem-weil-integral-constructible-linear], and $\psi_E$ respects multiplication by every constant scalar. For $E\subset L$ let $S^W_{L/E}$ be the specified strict-tower integral scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. The inverse of the ambient scalar/direct-image comparison of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension], transported through $\psi_E,\psi_L$ and the canonical finite-free completed scalar comparisons $\chi_{L/E}$ of [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison], gives natural isomorphisms
$$I_LS^Z_{L/E}\xrightarrow{\sim}S^X_{L/E}I_E.$$
Their raw rationalizations, with no Karoubi completion [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], give natural shift-compatible isomorphisms
$$\theta_{L/E}:I_L^{\mathrm{rat}}T^Z_{L/E}\xrightarrow{\sim}T^X_{L/E}I_E^{\mathrm{rat}}.$$
Here $T^W_{L/E}$ is the scalar extension on $D^b_c(W,E)$ specified by that raw rationalization. For $L=E$ the comparisons are identities under the prescribed unit identifications. For $E\subset L\subset M$, with the scalar associators $a^W$ of [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition], they satisfy
$$a^X\circ T^X_{M/L}(\theta_{L/E})\circ\theta_{M/L,T^Z_{L/E}K}
=\theta_{M/E,K}\circ I_M^{\mathrm{rat}}(a^Z_K).$$
These statements assert compatibility for the specified strict-tower functors and the indicated normalized comparisons; no full faithfulness assertion is included.

proof.text: At each finite coefficient subextension apply the single-field strict-model theorem. Choose witnesses inside this existential proof (no public definition chooses unspecified data).

Apply the integral comparison construction to that supplied family, obtaining ambient data, integral comparisons, normalization, unit, shift and cocycle laws. Assemble IntegralComparisons from those three fields.

Apply the rational assembly theorem to these integral data and their two law predicates. Pair its Comparisons and HasComparisonLaws with the integral data and HasIntegralLaws to obtain the original nested existential conclusion.
